mermaid:
---
title: Bookstore data model
---
erDiagram
  direction TB
  AUTHOR ||--o{ BOOK_AUTHOR : writes
  BOOK_AUTHOR }|--|| BOOK : credits
  PUBLISHER ||--o{ BOOK : publishes
  CUSTOMER ||--o{ ORDER : places
  ORDER ||--|{ ORDER_LINE : contains
  ORDER_LINE }o--|| BOOK : "is for"
  CUSTOMER ||--o{ REVIEW : writes
  REVIEW }o--|| BOOK : rates
  BOOK {
    uuid id PK
    string isbn UK
    string title
    uuid publisher_id FK
    date published_on
    decimal price
  }
  AUTHOR {
    uuid id PK
    string name
    string bio
  }
  BOOK_AUTHOR {
    uuid book_id PK, FK
    uuid author_id PK, FK
    int author_order
  }
  PUBLISHER {
    uuid id PK
    string name
    string country
  }
  CUSTOMER {
    uuid id PK
    string email UK
    string name
    string address
  }
  ORDER {
    uuid id PK
    uuid customer_id FK
    datetime placed_at
    string status
    decimal total
  }
  ORDER_LINE {
    uuid order_id PK, FK
    uuid book_id PK, FK
    int quantity
    decimal unit_price
  }
  REVIEW {
    uuid id PK
    uuid book_id FK
    uuid customer_id FK
    int rating
    string body
    datetime created_at
  }
